tokens.name: st-bg
tokens.usage: The sheet [stage]: the canvas ground, the paper fill inside every solid loft and polygon, the knock-out patch behind dimension values and bg labels, chip and toast grounds, text on an st-ink or st-rec chip.

tokens.name: st-grid
tokens.usage: Minor floor grid lines [grid], every 0.5 m, 0.6 px. Deliberately faint on st-bg: never text, never a mark that must be seen.

tokens.name: st-major
tokens.usage: Major floor grid lines [major], every 2 m, 0.6 px; the fill used if the hatch pattern cannot be made; the border of a ghost chip.

tokens.name: st-shadow
tokens.usage: Hatch lines [shadow]: sun shadows, the lot boundary band, hatched polygon faces (funbox slopes, kicker sides). A tone on st-bg, never text.

tokens.name: st-ink
tokens.usage: The drawing [ink]: loft silhouettes and rings, polygon edges, the ground line, bolts, the face, default lines and labels, the scale bar and title block; chip and toast text and borders. On st-bg and st-soft.

tokens.name: st-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary ink [muted]: the hatched band under an elevation ground line, title-block keys and sheet number, trick-toast detail, axes of small diagrams. Text on st-bg.

tokens.name: st-rec
tokens.usage: Signal red [accent and red]: contact dots and arrows, the centre of mass, bailed tricks (dimension lines, toast name), Order-changes outlines, Truth cells, the REC and REPLAY chips. Text and marks on st-bg; st-bg text on it.

tokens.name: st-warn
tokens.usage: The warn tone [warn] (tone: 'warn'): a caution that is not a failure. No shipped view uses it yet. Marks on st-bg; as text the light value is 4.46:1, just under 4.5:1 (a source value, kept exact).

tokens.name: st-soft
tokens.usage: The soft fill [soft]: a loft or polygon drawn with fill: 'soft' instead of paper. No shipped view uses it yet. st-ink reads on it.

tokens.name: st-blue
tokens.usage: Overlay hue [blue]: the autopilot's course (Course), the deck centre's flight path and its 50 ms ticks (Trail), landed-trick dimension lines (Dims), the chronophotograph's deck. Marks and 8–8.5 px labels on st-bg.

tokens.name: st-green
tokens.usage: Overlay hue [green]: named sites on the deck (Sites), rings and 8 px labels. Marks on st-bg; its labels are 4.34:1 in the light theme, just under 4.5:1 (a source value, kept exact).

tokens.name: st-violet
tokens.usage: Overlay hue [violet]: the skeleton's sticks and hollow joints (Rig), the chronophotograph's stick figures. Marks on st-bg.

tokens.name: st-amber
tokens.usage: Overlay hue [amber]: forces (Forces: the leg-force arrow and its newton label, foot-guide dashes) and the default tone of new force views. In the light theme it is 2.68:1 on st-bg, under 3:1 for marks and 4.5:1 for its 8 px labels: a source value, kept exact. Pair an amber label with bg: true or keep the number in st-ink.

tokens.name: st-teal
tokens.usage: Overlay hue [teal]: the deck nose's dashed flight path (Trail), the long-axis plot of the winding view. Marks on st-bg; its 8 px labels are 4.35:1 in the light theme, just under 4.5:1 (a source value, kept exact).

tokens.name: st-ghost
tokens.usage: Onion-skin outlines [ghost]: 0.8 px, drawn at opacity 0.18 to 0.68 so the oldest ghost fades. Marks on st-bg.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Workbench ground behind the stage toolbar and the hint line (kiln.css --bg).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Workbench text: the hint line's bold state word, menu text (kiln.css --ink). On bg and fill.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Workbench secondary text: the hint line's key list, menu descriptions, the box of an unticked overlay (kiln.css --ink-2). On bg.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Workbench hover fill of a menu row (kiln.css --fill). ink reads on it; ink-2 descriptions are 4.39:1 on it in the light theme (a source pair, kept exact).

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: Workbench 1 px rules: the line above the hint line, menu dividers (kiln.css --hair).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Workbench red: the fail banner's fill, the recording dot in the Clip menu (kiln.css --accent). Errors and recording only.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on the fail banner (skate.css writes #fff). Dark theme: 3.51:1 on accent, under 4.5:1 for 12 px text: a source value, kept exact.

families.plex: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Canvas
groups.note: Text the drafting context paints (app/draft.js text(): weight 500 unless asked, baseline middle). Sizes are CSS px at any zoom.

styles.name: canvas-label
styles.usage: g.label default (draft.js:358); title-block values; the label of a bg label sits on an st-bg patch 4 px taller than the text.

styles.name: canvas-label-sm
styles.usage: Overlay labels beside their marks: COM, the leg force in N, site names, winding captions (size: 8).

styles.name: canvas-dim
styles.usage: Dimension values, centred on the dimension line on an st-bg patch (draft.js:372).

styles.name: canvas-key
styles.usage: Title-block keys and sheet number (st-muted), scale-bar figures (st-ink) (draft.js:403-413).

styles.name: canvas-sheet-label
styles.usage: The first line of a compare sheet's label in replay (stage.jsx:51); its further lines are canvas-label at weight 400 in st-muted.

styles.name: canvas-default
styles.usage: What draft.text() sets when a call gives no size.

styles.name: canvas-title
styles.usage: The title block header, the one canvas text not in Plex (text(…, { mono: false }), draft.js:403).

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Chips in the stage's top-left corner (skate.css .chip), set in capitals (text-transform: uppercase) and tracked.

styles.name: chip-ghost
styles.sample: click the stage, then ↑ to push
styles.usage: A ghost chip: a hint in sentence case, untracked (.chip.ghost).

styles.name: toast-detail
styles.usage: The trick toast's measurement line, st-muted (.tricktoast span).

styles.name: toast-name
styles.usage: The trick toast's name (.tricktoast b), in capitals (text-transform: uppercase); 18px when the stage is 600px wide or less. st-rec with " · bail" for a bail.

styles.name: hint
styles.sample: ↑ push · ←→ carve · Space pop · drag to orbit
styles.usage: The hint line under the stage (kiln.css .hint): ink-2, its first word bold in ink.

styles.name: banner
styles.usage: The fail banner (skate.css .failbanner), its lead in bold.

spacing.note: The DOM parts laid over the canvas (app/skate.css, app/kiln.css).

tokens.name: stage-inset
tokens.usage: Chip row and trick toast from the stage's top corners; the fail banner from its bottom-left corner.

tokens.name: chip-gap
tokens.usage: Between chips in the chip row.

tokens.name: chip-pad-y
tokens.usage: Chip padding, top and bottom.

tokens.name: chip-pad-x
tokens.usage: Chip padding, left and right.

tokens.name: toast-pad-top
tokens.usage: Trick toast padding above the name.

tokens.name: toast-pad-x
tokens.usage: Trick toast padding left and right.

tokens.name: toast-pad-bottom
tokens.usage: Trick toast padding under the detail line.

tokens.name: toast-gap
tokens.usage: Between the toast's name and detail.

tokens.name: toast-top-narrow
tokens.usage: The toast's top offset when the stage is 600px wide or less, clear of the chip row.

tokens.name: banner-pad-y
tokens.usage: Fail banner padding, top and bottom.

tokens.name: banner-pad-x
tokens.usage: Fail banner padding, left and right.

tokens.name: hint-height
tokens.usage: Height of the hint line under the stage.

tokens.name: hint-pad-x
tokens.usage: Hint line padding left and right.

tokens.name: hint-gap
tokens.usage: Between the hint's state word and its key list.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Chips, toasts, the fail banner, the title block, menus: every stage part is square-cornered.

fontSize.note: The workbench's type steps the stage's DOM parts use (kiln.css).

tokens.name: fs-xs
tokens.usage: Overlay menu descriptions; the trick toast detail matches it.

tokens.name: fs-s
tokens.usage: The hint line, the fail banner, menu rows.

stroke.note: Canvas line widths in CSS px at any zoom (app/draft.js unless named).

tokens.name: stroke-silhouette
tokens.usage: A loft's outline: the union of its hulls stroked, then filled with st-bg, so 1 px shows (drawLoft, drawChains).

tokens.name: stroke-ring
tokens.usage: Rings and meridians on a loft, at opacity-ring.

tokens.name: stroke-ghost
tokens.usage: Onion-skin outlines in st-ghost.

tokens.name: stroke-ground
tokens.usage: The ground line of an elevation, in st-ink.

tokens.name: stroke-grid
tokens.usage: Floor grid lines, minor and major.

tokens.name: stroke-hatch
tokens.usage: Hatch lines in the shadow tile and the ground band.

tokens.name: stroke-poly
tokens.usage: Polygon edges and the lot boundary, unless the mark sets width.

tokens.name: stroke-overlay
tokens.usage: Default for lines, polylines, arrows, rings and dimension lines.

tokens.name: stroke-dim-ext
tokens.usage: Dimension extension lines.

tokens.name: stroke-dim-tick
tokens.usage: The 45° ticks at a dimension line's ends.

tokens.name: stroke-changes
tokens.usage: Order-changes outline of a part whose order just flipped, in st-rec.

tokens.name: stroke-trail-centre
tokens.usage: The deck centre's flight path (board.js:120).

tokens.name: stroke-trail-nose
tokens.usage: The deck nose's dashed flight path (board.js:121).

tokens.name: stroke-chrono-deck
tokens.usage: The deck as a line in the chronophotograph (D-03 chrono.js).

tokens.name: stroke-winding
tokens.usage: The two curves of the winding view (R-02 windingView.js).

tokens.name: stroke-fbd
tokens.usage: Leg-force arrows in the free-body diagram (D-04 fbd.js); contact arrows there are 1.2px.

hatch.note: Hatching and poché (app/draft.js hatchPattern, groundLine, drawBoundary).

tokens.name: hatch-tile
tokens.usage: The shadow hatch tile: one 45° line rising to the right per tile, so lines 6 px apart along a row and 4.2 px apart across.

tokens.name: hatch-angle
tokens.usage: Every hatch line rises to the right at 45°.

tokens.name: hatch-ground-pitch
tokens.usage: Spacing of the hatch lines in an elevation's ground band, in st-muted.

tokens.name: hatch-ground-band
tokens.usage: Depth of the hatched band under an elevation's ground line.

tokens.name: boundary-band
tokens.usage: Width of the hatched boundary band round the lot (terrain.js flatground; drawBoundary's default is 0.3 m).

tokens.name: opacity-ring
tokens.usage: Rings and meridians on a solid.

tokens.name: opacity-ghost-base
tokens.usage: A ghost outline is drawn at 0.18 + 0.5 a, a from (i + 1)/n: the oldest faintest.

tokens.name: opacity-ghost-span
tokens.usage: How much a ghost's opacity grows from oldest to newest.

tokens.name: opacity-ghost-fill
tokens.usage: The paper wash inside a ghost, as a fraction of its outline's opacity.

tokens.name: opacity-trail-centre
tokens.usage: The deck centre's flight path.

tokens.name: opacity-trail-nose
tokens.usage: The deck nose's flight path.

tokens.name: opacity-truth
tokens.usage: Truth cells painted in st-rec.

tokens.name: opacity-course
tokens.usage: The autopilot course's dashed legs.

tokens.name: opacity-dim-oldest
tokens.usage: Floor dimension lines fade by age: 0.35 + 0.65 (i + 1)/n over the last four tricks.

tokens.name: opacity-chrono-oldest
tokens.usage: Chronophotograph figures: 0.25 + 0.75 i/n.

tokens.name: dash-course
tokens.usage: The autopilot course between waypoints (controls.js).

tokens.name: dash-course-target
tokens.usage: From the board to the waypoint it is heading for.

tokens.name: dash-guide
tokens.usage: A foot guide: from the foot to the point of the deck it pulls (motors.js, Forces).

tokens.name: dash-trail-nose
tokens.usage: The deck nose's flight path.

tokens.name: dash-chrono-hips
tokens.usage: The hips' path in the chronophotograph.

marks.note: Dot and arrow sizes in CSS px.

tokens.name: dot-default
tokens.usage: g.dot radius when none is given; foot-guide ends.

tokens.name: dot-contact
tokens.usage: An active contact of the deck (Contacts), st-rec.

tokens.name: dot-joint
tokens.usage: A skeleton joint, hollow (Rig), st-violet.

tokens.name: dot-com
tokens.usage: The centre of mass (Rig), st-rec.

tokens.name: dot-bolt
tokens.usage: The four bolts per truck on the grip tape, st-ink, hidden when the grip faces away.

tokens.name: dot-trail-tick
tokens.usage: A tick on the deck centre's path every 50 ms.

tokens.name: dot-target
tokens.usage: The waypoint the autopilot is heading for.

tokens.name: ring-min-span
tokens.usage: A g.ring narrower than this on the sheet is drawn as a 3 px circle.

tokens.name: arrowhead-max
tokens.usage: Arrowhead length: min(7 px, half the arrow); its half-width is 0.45 of that.

tokens.name: dim-tick
tokens.usage: A dimension tick spans 8 px by 8 px (±4 px) at 45°, at any zoom.

tokens.name: dim-overshoot
tokens.usage: Extension lines run 12% of the offset past the dimension line.

tokens.name: truth-cell
tokens.usage: Side of a Truth cell on the sheet.

camera.note: The four named views (app/draft.js VIEWS) and the stage camera (app/ui/stage.jsx, app/host.js).

tokens.name: view-axo-yaw
tokens.usage: Axonometric: yaw. A trimetric chosen to read people and boards (from Loom Playtime).

tokens.name: view-axo-pitch
tokens.usage: Axonometric: pitch. Foreshortens x, y, z by 0.836, 0.891, 0.712.

tokens.name: view-front-yaw
tokens.usage: Front elevation (pitch 0): true lengths in x and y.

tokens.name: view-side-yaw
tokens.usage: Side elevation (pitch 0): true lengths in z and y.

tokens.name: view-plan-pitch
tokens.usage: Plan (yaw 0): true lengths in x and z.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: The sun direction (normalised; the way light travels): 57.9° high, 0.628 m of shadow offset per metre of height.

tokens.name: scale-elevation
tokens.usage: Pixels per metre at zoom 1 in axo, front and side: 5.5 m across or 3.1 m up.

tokens.name: scale-plan
tokens.usage: Pixels per metre at zoom 1 in plan: 7.5 m across the shorter side.

tokens.name: target-height
tokens.usage: The sheet centres 0.9 m above the ground under the board (0 in plan).

tokens.name: zoom-min
tokens.usage: Smallest zoom (wheel and slider).

tokens.name: zoom-max
tokens.usage: Largest zoom by the wheel; the slider stops at 4.

tokens.name: follow-half-life
tokens.usage: The camera spring's half-life while following the board; 0.6 s when Follow is off.

tokens.name: follow-lead
tokens.usage: The camera aims this far ahead along the board's velocity.

tokens.name: track-half-life
tokens.usage: The yaw spring's half-life when Track turns the sheet with the rider.

tokens.name: orbit-rate
tokens.usage: Radians of yaw per px of drag; pitch moves 0.006 rad per px, within -1 to 1.6 rad of the view's own.

tokens.name: drag-threshold
tokens.usage: A drag starts orbiting or panning after 4 px.

tokens.name: title-block-width
tokens.usage: The title block, bottom right, 10 px from the edges.

tokens.name: title-block-row
tokens.usage: One row per fact under a 17 px header (FORM SKATE and the sheet number).

tokens.name: title-block-min
tokens.usage: The title block is drawn only on a sheet at least this wide and high.

tokens.name: scale-bar-inset
tokens.usage: The scale bar's left end: 14 px from the left, 18 px from the bottom.

tokens.name: scale-bar-rule
tokens.usage: 1 m long; 25 cm if 1 m would pass 30% of the sheet's width; 5 m if 1 m is under 40 px. Quarters, the first and third filled 2 px high.
